readiness.title: Fiscal readiness

state.incomplete: Some invoice has no authorized CT-e. Issuing now would declare a document that does not exist.
state.ready: Every invoice has an authorized CT-e. The trip can be manifested.
state.manifested: A manifest was issued for this trip.
state.divergent: A CT-e changed after the manifest. Check before moving on — cancelling an MDF-e is your call.

quickCreate.title: New trip
quickCreate.intro: Scan or type the access key of the invoices leaving together. Only invoices not already on a trip come in.
quickCreate.failed: Could not create the trip. Check the invoices and try again.

issue.noDocument: Scan at least one available invoice.

routeAssembly.title: Build a route from the invoice search
routeAssembly.intro: Search the invoices leaving together with the same filters as the invoice list, then pick the fleet. The router splits the load across the vehicles and creates one trip for each.
routeAssembly.vehiclesSearch: Search by plate, make or model
routeAssembly.alreadyOnTrip: {{count}} is already on another trip and stays out.
routeAssembly.alreadyOnTrip_other: {{count}} are already on another trip and stay out.

failure.timeout: The router did not answer in time. The request is still queued and will run once the service is back — follow the trips instead of asking again, because a second request routes the same invoices twice.
failure.stale: The invoices changed while the route was being built. Search again and ask once more.
failure.network: Could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
failure.unknown: Could not build the route. Give this code to support: {{code}}.

issue.noDocument: Add at least one available invoice from the search.

routeAssembly.boundByDriver: {{count}} vehicle came with the driver and only leaves the trip if the driver does.
routeAssembly.boundByDriver_other: {{count}} vehicles came with the drivers and only leave the trip if they do.

valuation.empty: Pick the invoices and the vehicle to see the numbers.
